findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_articles · Public sink: search_articles, submit_brief.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_articles · Public sink: search_articles, submit_brief

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_packages" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List available CodeWays Website as a Service (WaaS) packages with multi-region pricing ($97/mo USD or R550/mo ZAR)." → after: "List CodeWays One preview-first plans (R250/pm ZA | $39/mo US), domain registration (R99/yr | $14/yr), and Done-For-You WaaS packages with regional pricing."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
